# Starter revision 3.3 fixture

Exact copies, taken at commit 9f7a492, of the revision 3.3 files that revision 3.4
changes: the Director block, the project section, the manifest, UPDATES.md and the
knowledge, requests, staffing and supervision cards (the cards are flat here; they
install under `cards/`). Tests use them to build a 3.3 installation and update its
block to the current revision. They are test data, not instructions; do not edit them.
